name: Mailbox
summary: Generic post-mounted letterbox with a rounded top and a side flag that can raise; for street, garden and mail scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the post stands on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the mailbox is room size (about 560 px tall)

params.name: anim
params.note: flag = the flag swings up over the first second and stays up; the others are gentle motions

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror (flag on the left when true)

author: krakujs
